message.content: This is the final review turn. All three in-scope claims (extreme values, subnormals/signed zeros, storage offset and tail masking) were tested with direct probes and rebutted with wide margins (max err/tol ratio ~7e-7 at small magnitudes, 7.6e-6 vs 0.655 tolerance at ±65504, offset and odd-N cases all clean, input preserved). The kernel's rationalized FP32 form is numerically robust across the entire stated FP16 domain. No new material, testable, in-scope problem has emerged from the evidence.
